name: Van Ness Plastic Molding Co
old_description: Family owned and operated for over 70 years, Van Ness is a leader in providing quality, pet-caring products that fit the needs of your best friend. Every Van Ness product is designed to meet our own industry leading standards for superior benchmarks in quality, functionality, style and safety.
about:
Van Ness Plastic Molding Co. was founded in 1945 in Clifton, New Jersey, and has remained a family-owned and operated business for more than 70 years. The company began as a plastics molding operation and gradually focused on pet-care products.

Today, Van Ness manufactures a range of pet products including litter boxes, carriers, and bamboo-based accessories under lines such as Calm Carrier, Trackless Litter Mat Tiles, and Ecoware. Production uses FDA-approved materials with full traceability to source, and the company emphasizes that all items are made in the United States.

The company serves the pet-care industry, supplying retailers, distributors, and direct consumers with products designed for dogs, cats, and small animals. Its customer base includes pet owners seeking domestically produced, safety-focused items; testimonials highlight high-sided litter pans that reduce scatter and carriers that lessen travel anxiety.

Van Ness differentiates itself through its commitment to domestic manufacturing, material traceability, and an eco-friendly bamboo product line, positioning its offerings as higher-standard alternatives in the pet market.
